products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates lmarena.ai, a community-driven platform described on its site as an AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models. The site positions the platform as a tool for real-world evaluation of large language models, image models, and code models, with user conversations contributing to a public leaderboard and to automated evaluation in which prompts are later sent to AI providers to score and compare their models. LMSYS is organized as a nonprofit.

The platform's primary tracked product, listed as LMSYS Arena Models, is characterized as a model evaluation and crowdsourced benchmarking tool intended for research transparency rather than production use. The site discloses that user conversations and certain personal information may be shared with AI providers and released publicly to support research, with an opt-out available for the automated evaluation use case. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP registry presence are recorded in the held facts.
